Since \(a\ge 1\), from
\[
4040=n(2a+n-1)\ge n(n+1)
\]
we get \(n\le 63\). Also \(n\mid 4040=2^3\cdot 5\cdot 101\). The largest divisor of \(4040\) at most \(63\) is \(40\).

For \(n=40\):
\[
2a+n-1=\frac{4040}{40}=101
\]
so
\[
a=\frac{101-40+1}{2}=31.
\]
Thus the representation is
\[
\boxed{31+32+\cdots+70}.
\]
